questions.question: Between 2021 and 2025, which calendar year had the highest total number of living organ donors recovered nationally?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Overview - National')
filtered = df[(df['Organ'] == 'All') & (df['Year'].isin([2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]))].copy()
filtered['Number of living organ donors recovered'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Number of living organ donors recovered'], errors='coerce')
max_row = filtered.loc[filtered['Number of living organ donors recovered'].idxmax()]
result = str(int(max_row['Year']))

questions.question: According to the organ donor demographics summary, how many living organ donors were classified as uninsured?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Donor Demographics')
row = df[(df['Category'].str.contains('Insurance', na=False)) & (df['Level'] == 'Uninsured')]
result = int(row['Donor Count'].values[0])

questions.question: In 2025, how many more male candidates than female candidates were added to the transplant waitlists across all organ types?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Waitlist-Candidate Registration')
row = df[(df['Candidate/Registration'] == 'Candidates') & (df['Year of Addition'] == 2025) & (df['Organ Type'] == 'All')].iloc[0]
male = int(row['Sex: Male'])
female = int(row['Sex: Female'])
result = male - female

questions.question: Which three individual organs had the highest number of distinct recipients from deceased donors in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Recipient Demographics')
sub = df[(df['Transplant Year'] == 2023) & (df['Donor Type'] == 'Deceased Donor') & (df['Organ Transplanted'] != 'All Transplanted Organ Types')].copy()
sub['Total Distinct Recipients'] = pd.to_numeric(sub['Total Distinct Recipients'], errors='coerce')
top3 = sub.sort_values(by='Total Distinct Recipients', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['Organ Transplanted'].tolist()

questions.question: Based on the donor demographics data, did female living donors outnumber male living donors overall?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('hrsa_organ_donation_transplantation.xlsx', sheet_name='Donor Demographics')
sub = df[(df['Category'].str.contains('Sex', na=False)) & (df['Donor Type Filter'] == 'Living Donor')]
female_count = int(sub[sub['Level'] == 'Female']['Donor Count'].values[0])
male_count = int(sub[sub['Level'] == 'Male']['Donor Count'].values[0])
result = 'yes' if female_count > male_count else 'no'

questions.question: What was the total number of living donor liver transplant recipients nationwide from 2021 through 2025?
questions.program:
